job.question: What evaluation criteria and weights does the Arizona Public Safety Personnel Retirement System (PSPRS) use in its RFP for non-discretionary investment consultant services?
job.expected_facts: 25% - relevant knowledge and experience in similar consulting engagements and current organizational capacity to provide experienced staff; 30% - quality and extent of the firm's capabilities in strategic advice, new investment identification and evaluation, operational due diligence, investment due diligence, manager performance reporting and monitoring, and back office support; 25% - demonstrated ability to meet service requirements (communicating with the CIO, investment team, Trustees and the Board's consultant, the operational plan, quality of assigned staff); 20% - overall cost of the proposed services.
job.acceptance: Accept concise synonymous descriptions of all four criteria at 25/30/25/20; sublists need not reproduce every phrase verbatim.

reviews.reason: The document is an SDCERS general investment consultant RFP, not an Arizona PSPRS RFP for non-discretionary investment consultant services. Its evaluation section provides general considerations but no 25/30/25/20 weights or explicit attribution to PSPRS.
